question: Who among the following won the silver in the World Athletics Championship - 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Neeraj Chopra**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Neeraj Chopra won the silver medal in the **men's javelin throw** at the **World Athletics Championships 2022**, which took place in **Eugene, Oregon, USA**.
 
• He achieved a throw of **88.13 meters** during the competition, finishing second behind **Jakub Vadlejch** from the Czech Republic, who won the gold medal.
 
• This medal was historically significant as it made Neeraj Chopra the **first Indian** to win a medal in javelin throw at the World Athletics Championships.
 
• It added to his accolades, which include winning a gold medal at the **Tokyo 2020 Olympics** (held in 2021) and establishing him as one of the top javelin throwers in the world.
 
• The championships were held in **Eugene, Oregon, USA**, from **July 15 to July 24, 2022**.
 
• This was the first time the World Championships were held in the United States.
 
• **Jakub Vadlejch**:
 
 
• The gold medalist from the Czech Republic who achieved a throw of **88.84 meters**, demonstrating his strength and technique.
 
• Vadlejch has been a strong competitor in javelin throw events and was a key contender throughout the championship.
 
 
 
• **Other Medalists**: T
 
 
• he bronze medal was won by **Keshorn Walcott** from Trinidad and Tobago, who threw **86.64 meters**.

• Avinash Sable
 
 
• Avinash Sable is a prominent Indian athlete specializing in middle-distance running, particularly the 3000 meters steeplechase.
 
• At the World Athletics Championships 2022, Sable competed in the men’s 3000m steeplechase.
 
• He finished in 11th place in the final with a time of 8:31.75.
 
 
 
• Priyanka Goswami is an Indian race walker, specializing in the **20 km race walk**.
 
 
• At the **World Athletics Championships 2022**, she competed in the women's 20 km race walk.
 
• Priyanka finished in **10th place** with a time of **1:29:00**. 
 
 
 
• Mirabai Chanu is a renowned weightlifter, competing in the **49 kg category**
